MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for Default Prove-Up Hearing.
Dept. 218, Comm. William R. Gargano, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Lois Jones, #3689.

Patrick D. Goggin, Esq. appeared with plaintiff Keith Dion, who was placed under oath and examined.
No appearance by defendant Golden Gate Funeral Escorts.
Dismissal without prejudice as to defendants Helke Gregory Nacua and Mobette Nacua were filed on July 24, 2008.
Default was to defendant Golden Gate Funeral Escorts was entered May 1, 2008.
Doe defendants were dismissed on May 11, 2009.

After hearing the evidence presented, and good cause appearing, the Court rules in favor of Plaintiff Keith Dion, and against the Defaulted Defendant Golden Gate Funeral Escorts as follows:

Damages/Principal - $25,000.00.
Costs - $499.20, for a total judgment in the amount of $25,499.20.

Judgment was submitted to and signed by the Court.
